body:
We were starting to make some copy constructors explicit, so I'd change to that form here.

```suggestion
			T local_copy(p_elem);
```
Arguably we could adopt the same, along with a `DEV_ASSERT` to check or something, but I agree that might be unnecessarily user hostile.
If we do I think this should be a separate PR, because of the risk of regressions, so easier to revert.
